comparison.objective: Mount an emergency-stop button through a panel and secure its rear locking ring.
comparison.physical_skill: Keyed tab/notch alignment, through-hole insertion, bimanual retention, and threaded ring tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Button flush and aligned, ring turned and snug, assembly released and still; explicit insertion and seating tiers.
comparison.reason: Keyed assembly and threading do not exercise selective passage of media while retaining workpieces.
